context: 18 discovery runs finished; holdout grid 64/96 verification is in progress. Additional controls answer material finite-size, finite-time, integration, and symmetry alternatives. They do not relabel old failures or change original gates.

duration.purpose: Distinguish delayed growth from permanent suppression. Rerun all from t=0; do not continue a selected surviving lump.

size.purpose: Same spacing as grid48 length64, same physical noise bandwidth and RMS, independent larger volume, no tiling. Restrict any claim if finite-size modes explain it.

symmetry.purpose: Exactly conjugate initial fields, conjugate momenta. Symmetry predicts equal component densities/energies for all time. Treat that as validation, never as a new discovery.

dt.purpose: Half time step versus registered holdout, numerical drift should decrease; finite-grid changes are not counted as physical changes.

interpretation: These are classical field concentrations, not material membranes. A life-vessel connection must be separately justified; visual concentration alone does not qualify. Original preregistration and all runs remain unchanged.
